chapter: Banjo career, Armstrong and the Liberty Bell
title: How the Liberty Bell band got its name
summary: Vincent says he chose the name from novels he read about the Liberty Boys of '76. The band became popular and its alumni became known worldwide.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Why did you get that name Liberty Bell? I get him that name. Oh, you get him that name.

You know, I used to read them novels all the time. You know, the British and the, the soldiers and the fight. You know, like the comedy book. I had to read that all the time. And it says, the Liberty Boys are 76. And I just picked out the Liberty Bell, you know.
I'm asking did they have a new Liberty Bell?

So did you have a new Liberty Bell? A new Liberty Bell? New? New? Did they have a new Liberty Bell band? A new Liberty Bell band? No, not after we broke up. But our band got popular. And all of them all the world, they know them. They know them. They're like Willie Hump and all of them. Lewis Armstrong. All them fellas like that. Did you know Amos White? You know Amos White?
